name: Retch Rust
text:
You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal. All creatures in a 30-foot cone take floor((@actor.level -8/2)+4)d10 slashing damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your class DC. A metal creature that fails its save also takes floor((@actor.level -8/2)+2)d4 persistent,slashing damage.

---

Level (+2) The cloud's slashing damage increases by 1d10 and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.
